entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: Swamp city on Guul Draz and capital of Zendikar's vampires, now a fortress and refuge of free vampires.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar where Malakir stands.

entities.name: Kalastria District
entities.description: Oldest and wealthiest district of Malakir on the highest ground; Drana's stronghold.

entities.name: Nirkana District
entities.description: District of canals home to the Nirkana assassins and spies.

entities.name: Urnaav District
entities.description: Transitional district between Emevera and Kalastria where some vampires still live.

entities.name: Emevera District
entities.description: Ruined, flooded district that now forms a barrier against Eldrazi incursions.

entities.name: Ghet District
entities.description: Abandoned, submerged district claimed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: House Emevera
entities.description: Vampire house that sabotaged Ghet by diverting water to flood it.

entities.name: House Ghet
entities.description: Vampire house that pledged allegiance to the Titans under Kalitas's command.

entities.name: Nirkana
entities.description: Infamous assassins and spies of Malakir.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: Bloodchief of House Kalastria who escaped the slaughter and reclaimed Malakir.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: Vampire to whom House Ghet pledged allegiance under the Titans.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose awakening turned half of Malakir's vampires against the rest.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: Ancient empire to which Malakir once belonged.

events.summary: Ulamog awakens; half of Malakir's vampires fall under his sway and turn on the rest, sparking a civil war that ruins the city.
events.quote: When Ulamog awoke, half the city’s vampire population fell under the titan’s sway and turned on the rest

events.summary: The dikes of Emevera collapse when the city falls, and the swamp reclaims the district.
events.quote: the dikes collapsed and the swamp reclaimed the district

events.summary: Drana escapes the slaughter and returns with free survivors to reclaim Malakir and turn it into a fortress.
House Ghet pledges allegiance to the Titans under Kalitas.
events.quote: House Ghet itself pledged allegiance to the Titans under Kalitas ’s command.

relations.quote: is a swamp city on the continent of Guul Draz on Zendikar
House Ghet itself pledged allegiance to the Titans
Malakir once belonged to the ancient Makindi Empire before its fall.
